zh.title: 臺中機場無人機防禦系統完成驗收 預計月底前發揮功能
zh.summary: 臺中機場無人機防禦系統完成驗收，預計10月底前發揮功能。
body: 中央社報導，國防部長顧立雄表示，臺中機場的無人機防禦系統（UDS）已完成驗收，預計10月底以前可發揮相關功能。顧立雄說，待複驗完成、空軍各基地陸續建置完畢後，UDS可用於幹擾第一、二型無人機。
顧立雄另表示，今年已開始進行系統構型變更，可將5.17GHz納入幹擾頻段。相關背景是，臺中清泉崗機場9月8日晚間有無人機入侵，戰機及民航機因此暫停起降；當晚8時2分恢復起降作業，期間影響民航班機2架次及軍機8架次。

en.title: Taichung Airport (TXG) Drone Defense System Accepted, Expected to Function by Month-End
en.summary: Taichung Airport's drone defense system passed acceptance; 顧立雄 expects it to function before October's end.
body: CNA reported that Defense Minister 顧立雄 said the drone defense system (UDS) at Taichung Airport (TXG) has completed acceptance. He said it should be able to perform its functions before the end of October. 顧立雄 also said configuration changes to include the 5.17 GHz band in the system's jamming frequencies began this year.

顧立雄 said the UDS can interfere with Type 1 and Type 2 drones after reinspection is complete and installation at the air force bases is completed. The report also noted that drone activity at Taichung Ching Chuan Kang Airport on September 8 led to fighter and civil aircraft temporarily stopping takeoffs and landings. Operations resumed at 8:02 p.m.; the disruption affected two civil-flight movements and eight military-aircraft movements.

image.subject: Eurocontrol delivers iNM Wave 2.5.1, expanding eEAD AIP production
image.description: 本篇所引官方新聞稿的原始配圖；圖片拍攝時間及是否為事件現場以原發布單位說明為準。

zh.title: Eurocontrol交付iNM 2.5.1波次 擴增eEAD AIP製作服務
zh.summary: Eurocontrol交付iNM Wave 2.5.1，擴增eEAD AIP製作服務
body: Eurocontrol表示，已交付iNM Wave 2.5.1。此波次將航空資訊出版（AIP）製作服務納入iNM Digital Platform，並屬於從現行European AIS Database（EAD）逐步轉向enhanced eEAD的工作。
eEAD AIP Production服務可讓航空資訊服務（AIS）提供者直接以eEAD中的單一整合資訊來源製作AIPs、eAIPs及其他AIS文件。Eurocontrol表示，這項服務有助於加強提供者維護的資料與最終發布給使用者的資訊之間的一致性。
Eurocontrol指出，超過60個國家向eEAD提供航空資訊，另有200多個組織使用該系統查閱航圖、AIPs、NOTAM及其他AIS資料。

en.title: Eurocontrol delivers iNM Wave 2.5.1, expanding eEAD AIP production
en.summary: Eurocontrol delivers iNM Wave 2.5.1, adding AIP production services to the eEAD platform
body: Eurocontrol says it has delivered Wave 2.5.1 of its integrated Network Management (iNM) programme. The release expands the iNM Digital Platform to include aeronautical information publication (AIP) production, as part of a gradual migration from the European AIS Database (EAD) to the enhanced eEAD.

The eEAD AIP Production service enables aeronautical information services (AIS) providers to produce AIPs, eAIPs and other AIS documents directly from a single integrated information source in eEAD. Eurocontrol says this strengthens consistency between data maintained by AIS providers and information ultimately published for users.
More than 60 States provide aeronautical information to eEAD, while over 200 organisations use the system to access charts, AIPs, NOTAMs and other AIS data.
